extra.message: Unsafe Pickle Deserialization — Remote Code Execution on the server, full compromise. [verified: The function acct_bundle_thaw_174 uses pickle.loads() on attacker-controlled input (request body or GET blob parameter) after only a gate check (_wrk_gate), which does not sanitize the payload. No validation or safe deserialization is present, enabling remote code execution if the gate is bypassed.]

Path Traversal and Arbitrary File Write — Arbitrary file write, potentially overwriting application files, leading to code execution or data corruption. [verified: No sanitization on 'ref' parameter; Path.join with BASE_EXPORT_DIR allows traversal via '../' sequences. The file content is controlled via GET parameters, enabling arbitrary file write outside intended directory.]
